["With Sam","The observation blister holds two if neither minds the other's elbows, and Sam doesn't. The ship is dark behind you and the stars don't move. Sam is already telling you about something that happened at the last port, and by the second mug has told you about two more. Every few minutes the hull ticks as the sun side warms."]

["With Sam","You sit with Sam in the galley at the slack end of the watch, over two mugs, with the hot plate ticking as it cools. Sam listens for the pump to change its note, and relaxes a little when you stay. Somewhere aft the recycler changes its note and changes back."]

["With Sam","Sam is on the crate by the hold hatch, where the hull carries the drive noise and the light is bad, and moves over when you come down the ladder. You sit on the deck plate with your back to the hatch. Sam has saved you the good end of the loaf, and doesn't mention it. A hatch number is stenciled on the frame above their head."]

["With Sam","The observation blister holds two if neither minds the other's elbows, and Sam doesn't. The ship is dark behind you and the stars don't move. Sam is working out, aloud and not quite to you, what the next run should clear. Every few minutes the hull ticks as the sun side warms."]

["With Sam","The observation blister holds two if neither minds the other's elbows, and Sam doesn't. The ship is dark behind you and the stars don't move. Sam sits with a hand around the cord at their wrist and says nothing for a long time, comfortably. Every few minutes the hull ticks as the sun side warms."]

["With Sam","You sit with Sam in the galley at the slack end of the watch, over two mugs, with the hot plate ticking as it cools. Sam has a view on the galley, the rota, and the way you hold a mug, and shares them. Somewhere aft the recycler changes its note and changes back."]

["With Sam","You sit with Sam in the galley at the slack end of the watch, over two mugs, with the hot plate ticking as it cools. Sam wants to know how the drive works, what you do on watch, and whether you've ever been to Titan. Somewhere aft the recycler changes its note and changes back."]

["With Sam","You sit with Sam in the galley at the slack end of the watch, over two mugs, with the hot plate ticking as it cools. Sam is on water tonight, and says so with an effort that's its own kind of story. Somewhere aft the recycler changes its note and changes back."]

["With Sam","You find Sam on the bench in the engine room, where it's warm and loud and nobody sits unless they have to, with a mug balanced on the pump housing. They make room. Sam answers a question about the weather with a question about you. The drive runs up a hair on a correction and settles."]

["With Sam","You find Sam on the bench in the engine room, where it's warm and loud and nobody sits unless they have to, with a mug balanced on the pump housing. They make room. Sam asks if you have slept, and doesn't take \"fine\" for an answer. The drive runs up a hair on a correction and settles."]

["With Sam","You sit with Sam in the galley at the slack end of the watch, over two mugs, with the hot plate ticking as it cools. Sam tells you about the worst day they've had on a ship, quietly, as if it were a recipe. Somewhere aft the recycler changes its note and changes back."]

["With Sam","You sit with Sam in the galley at the slack end of the watch, over two mugs, with the hot plate ticking as it cools. Sam has a photograph out, and puts it away when you come in, and then takes it out again. Somewhere aft the recycler changes its note and changes back."]

Sam is on the crate by the hold hatch, where the hull carries the drive noise and the light is bad, and moves over when you come down the ladder. You sit on the deck plate with your back to the hatch. Sam tells you about the worst day they've had on a ship, quietly, as if it were a recipe. A hatch number is stenciled on the frame above their head.

The observation blister holds two if neither minds the other's elbows, and Sam doesn't. The ship is dark behind you and the stars don't move. Sam is easy company. Every few minutes the hull ticks as the sun side warms.
